responsibility: Generate only synthetic source fixtures and the existing test scenarios.

interfaces.input: sources.seed.generate_all / scenario APIs; dates + sources.config.SourceEnvironment supplied by caller; source_schemas.py contract.
interfaces.output: Synthetic source databases and CSV/XML inbox deliveries.

invariants: Strictly increasing dates; prefix-stable positional date roles; exact decimals.
No dependency on runner configuration or production data.
external_resources: Caller-supplied source/consumer SQL connections and inbox path; no AWS resources.
state_and_effects: Fixture generation/scenarios can recreate source data or reset the synthetic consumer; inspect command scope before use. Not an ingestion job.

lifecycle.build: Offline build_artifacts.py --unit apps/source-generator; ZIP requires the declared locked external Python environment.
lifecycle.deploy: Local Python application/API; no dedicated cloud deployment. Runner bundles only its declared public_dependencies.
lifecycle.rollback: Rebuild/test selected Git commit with locked dependencies; does not revert data/schema/state.
lifecycle.remove: Update declared callers and local packaging; preserve data, contracts and unrelated executable units.
